remarks: More style, less maintanence! Enjoy the space and feel of a luxury home withithout the upkeep. High-end finishes, custom upgrades, and meticulous attention to detail create an impeccable space. From the moment you step into the foyer you'll be impressed by the custom millwork, an elegant white oak staircase, and refined craftsmanship throughout. The open-concept layout and soaring vaulted ceiling fill the home with a surprising amount of natural light. In the living room a gorgeous floor-to-ceiling tiled fireplace creates a striking focal point. The beautifully appointed kitchen is loaded with premium features, natural stone countertops, custom hood vent, stainless appliances, and garbage disposal. The true showstopper is the custom butler's pantry/prep kitchen! This beautiful and highly functional space offers additional storage, prep space, coffee bar, and continues the theme of custom upgrades throughout. Upstairs, you'll find great sized double primary bedrooms each en-suite bathrooms and ample closet space! There's also a versatile office nook perfect for working from home or a cozy space to read a book. The newly finished basement adds even more living space and flexibility. Whether you envision a third bedroom, family room, home office, fitness area, or lounge, this space is ready to meet your needs. Outside, you can relax on the lovely patio. HOA covers exterior maintainence and lawncare. This exceptional home is truly move-in ready and offers a super convienient location! Don't miss out on this stylish home in a beautiful community.
